origin: Long-context derivation of the frozen 13-case drift-probe bank. Synthetic content only. ABCD protocol revision 3.

protocol.boundary: One manual compaction after every intermediate turn. With 7 turns the handoff arm performs native x3, Handoff, native x3; the native arm performs native x7.
protocol.extraNoiseForLongerRuns: To probe more boundaries, append further noise turns after the last core turn and before the final turn.
protocol.finalTurn: Sent after the last boundary. It never restates earlier facts; the deliverable depends on retained context.
